offering_description.value: Issues fixed, fixed indexed and life insurance policies sold to individuals saving for or living in retirement. Sells mainly through independent agents, banks and broker-dealers, and earns money from the spread on invested policy funds and from premiums.

primary_products.value: fixed indexed annuities; fixed rate annuities; indexed universal life insurance

items.detail: individuals saving for retirement, retirees and families buying life insurance

end_markets.value: retirement planning; personal financial services; life insurance

items.detail: investment income spread on annuity deposits and life insurance premiums
takes in policyholder premiums and deposits, invests them, and pays benefits to individual policyholders

geography_served.detail: licensed insurer selling across most US states

specialization.detail: fixed and indexed annuities and indexed life insurance sold to the same retirement-focused customers

items.detail: independent insurance agents and broker-dealers selling policies
banks and independent marketing organizations distributing annuities

regulatory_exposure.detail: high: insurance licensed and supervised by state insurance regulators; registered index-linked annuities overseen by SEC and FINRA
